svg.title: 1. Reference architecture: control plane and tiered application plane
svg.text: Control plane account (shared by every tenant, run by the SaaS provider)
Pool account: Basic + Pro tenants (shared infrastructure, tenant context on every request)
us-east-1 and eu-central-1 (one pool stack per region)
Silo accounts: one AWS account per Enterprise tenant
Another Enterprise tenant: same template, own account
Multi-tenant SaaS on AWS: one control plane, a pooled application plane for Basic and Pro, a silo account per Enterprise tenant
Silo accounts are vended by Control Tower Account Factory,
tagged tenant_id, and deployed by the same pipeline as
the pool. Usage events still flow to the control plane.
